title: a16z Podcast: Telepresence and Tech for a Distributed Workforce

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: It's an ugly, outdated word for an attractive and current/ emerging phenomenon where people can work from anywhere, anytime.
reader_summary.overview: It's an ugly, outdated word for an attractive and current/ emerging phenomenon where people can work from anywhere, anytime. It's technology for the way we work today. But is it as easy as adding good tech to a constantly evolving problem?

key_points.text: Well, if you can't hire talent locally, you can hire them remotely.
That constraint is the easier of all the other requirements to relax.
